name: POST /api/leadflow/leads/:id/log-attempt - record a contact attempt, and refuse the ones that do not count
description:
Enforces the VALID HUMAN ATTEMPT definition from SOP §04: the rep reviewed the context, initiated a TRACKED call from the approved number or dialer, logged a reliable disposition and confirmed NEXT.

A TASK CLICK OR A BULK EMAIL CANNOT SATISFY THE CLOCK (12ce1f53-ba07-4f62-a2ac-a0b065100b28#AC1), and the refusal is TYPED so the rep learns which requirement was missing rather than being told "invalid". Without this the SLA measures ACTIVITY instead of CONTACT, and a queue can be cleared to 100% attainment by somebody who clicked twelve tasks and spoke to nobody. MEASURED LIVE: task_click returned 422 KIND_CANNOT_SATISFY, bulk_email returned 422, a tracked_call missing its disposition returned 422 NO_DISPOSITION, and a complete tracked call returned 201.

THE ORDER OF THE CHECKS IS PART OF THE CONTRACT. Kind is checked first, because telling a rep who sent a mass mailshot that they forgot a disposition would imply that adding one would have worked.

422 RATHER THAN 400, and the attempt is STILL RECORDED. The request is well formed and the work did happen; what it cannot do is satisfy the clock. "The rep did nothing" and "the rep did something that does not count" are different facts, and coaching needs both - so the row is written either way with satisfies_sla false and the refusal reason stored beside it.

THE FIRST VALID ATTEMPT WINS. first_response_at is stamped with COALESCE, so a second call an hour later cannot rewrite the response time and turn a met SLA into a different number.

A DATABASE CHECK BACKS THE RULE: an attempt row cannot carry satisfies_sla true without a tracked call reference, a disposition and a next action, so no writer can mint a satisfying attempt out of nothing. QA: depends on register and login.

testCases.name: A task click is recorded but refused as SLA evidence
A bulk email is refused for the same reason
A tracked call with no disposition is refused, naming the missing evidence
NEGATIVE: an unknown attempt kind is refused
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: kind must be one of tracked_call, manual_call, task_click, bulk_email, individual_email, sms, voicemail
errorCases.when: an unrecognised attempt kind is supplied. Accepting it would let a new spelling quietly become a category nothing in the report understands.

errorCases.message: A task click does not satisfy the response SLA
errorCases.when: the attempt is a task click, a bulk email, an SMS or a voicemail. Recorded, but it does not stop the clock: activity is not contact.
a call attempt carries no dialer reference, so it cannot be verified.
the outcome was not recorded, which is what makes the attempt auditable.
the rep left the record with no next action, which SOP §04 forbids.

errorCases.message: The attempt does not record that the rep reviewed the context
Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
